newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse index eases as prices drift.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse index eases as prices drift.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index eased marginally on Wednesday, as prices drifted reflecting bearish sentiment, bourse officials said.
The index lost 16.37 points to close at 3280.31.
Turnover was posted at 37.675 million shillings on 728,505 shares from 16.411 million shillings 379,811 shares on Tuesday.
"Given that most companies have announced their results, investors do not expect much. So when they get a chance to sell, they're offloading," a senior broker said.

Some brokers said a number of investors appeared to have opted to count their losses in national carrier Kenya Airways and offloaded their shares hoping to make at least marginal gains in recently issued Serena Lodges & Hotels.
Kenya Commercial Bank eased to 88.50 from 93 while Standard Chartered Bank was unchanged at 44.50.
Uchumi Supermarket eased to 36.75 from 38 while Kenya Airways was unchanged at 8.0 shillings.
Rea Vipingo Plantations edged to 9.05 from 8.80 while Sasini Tea & Coffee closed at 76 from 75.50.
A. Baumann dropped to 21 from 40.50 -- a downward adjustment brokers attributed to its trading without dividend.
Kenya Breweries closed at 58 from 58.50 while Kenya Power & Lighting Co gained 1.0 to 124.
The Central Bank of Kenya floating-rate treasury bond traded 55 million shillings at between 101.2000 percent and 101.5024 percent.
